_README: Human-labeled from SOURCE (src/routes/*.js, src/models/*.js). Never regenerate from the parser. See docs/specs/2026-05-31-corpus-accuracy-harness.md.
_endpoints_note: Routes are declared on a Router with no app.use() mount in this fixture, so the declared paths ARE the faithful ground truth (no /api prefix exists to compose). Matched as a set, so the cross-file duplicate `GET /` collapses to one.
_entities_note: KNOWN GAP (surfaced by this harness): the JS parser does not extract Mongoose schemas as db_model nodes, so entity recall is currently 0 for this fixture. Baseline-only dimension; not a hard target until JS entity extraction lands.
_key_call_edges_note: Route handlers delegate to injected service singletons; service->model calls (find/save) are Mongoose methods absent from source, correctly unresolved. Caller names are anonymous route handlers, so matched on callee + confidence.
